itineraries.title: Five days on the Costa Smeralda
itineraries.intro: Porto Cervo, the granite coves of the Costa Smeralda and the Maddalena archipelago twenty minutes to the north.

days.note: Board in Olbia; a first swim off Tavolara.
The marina and the boutiques; dinner at the Piazzetta.
A day at anchor in the bay; lunch ashore at the hotel.
Cala Corsara and the pink sands of Budelli in the Maddalena archipelago.
A morning in the old town; disembark in Olbia.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Olbia to the Maddalena archipelago
itineraries.intro: The north-east of Sardinia and the Bonifacio strait: the Costa Smeralda, La Maddalena, Lavezzi and a night beneath Bonifacio’s cliffs.

days.note: Board in Olbia; an evening at anchor off Tavolara.
Marinella bay and the marina village.
Porto Cervo and the Costa Smeralda coves.
Cala Coticcio, then Spargi and Budelli.
Cross the strait to the Lavezzi islets’ pale coves.
A night in the fjord-like harbour beneath the citadel.
Return across the strait; a last lunch at anchor, disembark in Olbia.
